description: Update attributes of one holding (stack) by holding_id (get ids from search_collection/where_is). Changing location is a physical move and reconciles allocation statuses like move_holding. Reducing quantity below the allocated amount is rejected — deallocate first. origin printed_proxy/bought_proxy force is_proxy=true and it cannot be unset.

location.description: Location id or name — this physically moves the stack

origin.description: How the card was acquired (mutually exclusive). printed_proxy/bought_proxy force is_proxy=true. is_proxy/is_signed/is_altered are independent flags that combine freely with any origin (a gift proxy = origin "gift" + is_proxy=true).

name: update_holding
title: Update holding
